notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Hello Commanders! A new tournament begins at Deuterium Wars - Craftsmanship. Win to get rare blueprints. And to make the battles even more epic, we add two completely new epic weapons. Read about full innovations, balance and fixes that are waiting for you in this update in the full patchnote.

[h1]Innovations[/h1]
[olist]
[*] We’re launching tournament for the each MK which is lasting 1 month. It will provide awards in the form of boxes with rare blueprints (of unique rarity and higher), containers with resources, a pleasant amount of experience and credits.
[*] Added 2 epic weapons for MK-2:
[list]
[*] epic rocket launcher “Stinger”
[*] epic shotgun “Rout”
[/list]
[*] Added exclusive and epic weapon containers for MK-2.
[*] Added 2 epic and 4 exclusive decors for MK-2.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32553324/d42bdfadb5ecfdee5b0639fcb90bf73b339a1451.png[/img]

[h1]Items Balance[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Stealth Detection bonus has been changed to Angular weapon velocity bonus and engine power bonus on the epic shell “Leviathan”. Its durability value has been changed from 4200 to 4180.
[*] Missile explosion damage was increased by 10% for the epic heavy rocket launcher “Thunder”, the duration of the periodic damage effect was increased by 33%, and its total damage increased by 21%.
[*] The minimum and maximum damage from a projectile explosion for the exclusive gun "Uncle Bo" was increased by 80 points, and the effect of periodic fire damage was added, dealing up to 718 damage in 5 seconds.
[*] The minimum and maximum direct damage of the exclusive gun "Typhoon" was increased by 20 points.
[*] Damage Block Chance bonuses have been slightly increased on items that have them, and now better match to incoming damage values on both MKs.
[*] Promocode for update: XRE6-SPJN-8AU6
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32553324/c9e0dd9a313a9d4bacd56a226cd58517879a59c3.png[/img]

[h1]Bugfix[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Fixed displaying of the plasma ball effect on the “Proton” epic energy cannon in the friends interface and on the hovercraft panel in the hangar.
[*] Fixed “A” modificators models disassembly on MK-2 (“220UN-A”, “230EX-A” etc.).
[*] Fixed required level on Fireproof and Electroinsulating plates on MK-2.
[/olist]

That's all for today. And do not forget that if in your opinion, something doesn’t work as it should in the game, you can always tell us about it on our server in Discord (https://discord.gg/deuteriumwars)

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello Commanders! Even more unusual weapons have appeared in Deuterium Wars - the legendary energy gun for the MK-2: “Death Ray” and the exclusive acid rocket launcher for the MK-2: “Comet-Z” have been added! And also gadgets and enhancements with new modifications. In addition, there are 4 new decors for MK2. Read about these and other changes in the full patchnote!

[h1]Daily events[/h1][olist]
[*] Tournament rewards in weekend events have been improved:
[list]
[*] the number of prizes with the best award has been increased;
[*] for the events "Totem Master" and "Free ammunition" you can now get a battle modifier of exclusive or unique rarity;
[*] in the event “Bullet Whistle” at MK-2, the experience reward for prizes now scales depending on the character's level (reaching the maximum value at level 60) and, in general, has become more tangible.
[/list]
[/olist]

[h1]Turrets balance[/h1][olist]
[*] Reserves of durability and defense for Flamethrower and Sentry Turrets were reduced by 20% by 1400+ PP.
[*] Now the durability of large stationary turrets grows more smoothly in the interval 400-1000 PP.
[*] For the destruction of the Flamethrower Turret, you will now receive not 200, but 300 points, just like for the Missile and Heavy Turrets.
[/olist]

[h1]Arming[/h1][olist]
[*] The legendary energy gun for the MK-2: “Death Ray” was added to the game!
[*] An exclusive “Comet-Z” acid rocket launcher for the MK-2 was also added to the game, the missiles of which, in addition to the main damage from acid, inflict periodic radiation damage.
[*] Also, exclusive “Swift-160EX-H” and “Eagle-260EX-H” drones were added with a big passive repair bonuses, however, at the cost of weaker weapons and airframe. They repair their master and significantly increase his survival. Such drones cannot be obtained as a reward or from containers, but it will be possible to get blueprints and create them using craft.
[*] Added 6 exclusive bombs for MK-1 and MK-2 with a built-in bonus of fire, energy or acid Damage Absorption (depending on the main type of bomb damage). Such bombs can be earned from exclusive containers.
[*] Added 4 exclusive mine gadgets for MK-1 and MK-2 with a built-in bonus of fire or energy Damage Absorption (depending on the main damage of the mine). Such mines can also be earned from exclusive containers.
[*] In addition, 16 drones were added with less significant passive repair bonuses for the MK-1 and MK-2, which can be obtained from containers.
[*] Now, “Amper” and “Amper-M2” deal damage from an explosion with energy, not fire.
[*] The direct damage of the “Mr. Cracker” epic machine gun was increased by 5%, and the probability of an effect of increasing incoming damage on the enemy was increased from 5% to 10% per shot.
[*] Ammunition critical damage bonuses have been recalculated and now better correspond to the current realities in the game, taking into account other modifiers. In general, these bonuses have grown significantly.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32553324/d74059708675070ef9be766b0928d7f96d458cff.png[/img]

[h1]Other innovations[/h1][olist]
[*] Added 4 new decors of exclusive rarity for MK-2.
[*] A warning hint has been added on the “Explosive Starter Pack” about the maximum level to which it is available for purchase.
[*] The epic resource no longer appears guaranteed in the Sunday Store assortment. However, now it can appear in Daily Store assortment every day with a 5% chance.
[*] Improved rewards for reaching 125 and 140 levels.
[*] Promocode: 993N-TVND-BZWD
[/olist]

[h1]Bugfix[/h1][olist]
[*] The process of the epic “Amper-M2” upgrading has been fixed.
[*] The effect of glow in the battle has been fixed for “Amper-M2”.
[*] Fixed icons of energy shields of an unique and exclusive rarity on the MK-2, displayed on the gadget button in battle.
[*] Fixed the disappearance of “Explosive Starter Pack” after level 20 and after buying another pack. Now it correctly remains active up to level 25, regardless of the fact of purchasing other packs.
[*] Fixed several errors in English localization.
[/olist]

That's all for today. And do not forget that if in your opinion, something doesn’t work as it should in the game, you can always tell us about it on our server in Discord (https://discord.gg/deuteriumwars)

notes.title: Update 1.0.3. Halloween
notes.notes:
Friends welcome the Halloween update! Today's menu features Halloween Drop, Halloween Hangar, Halloween tournament, Halloween Pumpkins and the Pumpkin patch. But that's not all! We have added 3 new weapons for MK2: the legendary “Pyroclasm” Energy Shotgun, the “Mr. Cracker” epic machine gun and the “Proton” epic energy gun. Rather into battle, but first read the full patchnotes!

[h1]Celebrate Halloween[/h1][olist]
[*] We launched a two-week Halloween holiday tournament, for completing the tasks of which you can get the Creepy Chest and Rusty Box. The first contains a random element of a Halloween costume of exclusive or epic rarity, as well as a unique blueprint of clothes. And the second is a random item from the Scavenger set. The best gladiators will receive exclusive “Jack’s Lantern” mines and an epic machine gun for the MK-2!
[*] An additional drop will be included during the holiday, as a reward for a fight at the Arena you can get a random element of a Halloween costume, “Jack’s Lantern” or “Battle Fireworks”!
[*] Exclusive “Pumpkin Bombs” were added to the game - try to get them as a reward for an Arena fight during the holiday.
[*] During the festive tournament, an epic patch “Pumpkin” was added to the Shop’s assortment, which allows you to send an animated pumpkin smile to the chat.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32553324/b44e4e99ae0ab733e0fd8de37e51793c6a7b1e06.png[/img]

[h1]Item balance[/h1][olist]
[*] The angular velocity of high-precision guns “Amper” and “Amper-M2” was reduced from 5 to 3 rad./sec. (from 286 to 171 degrees / second).
[*] Now the direct damage from the projectiles used in the high-precision “Amper” and “Amper-M2” guns is physical, not energy, and it is possible to dodge it.
[*] The critical damage bonus was increased on the “Thunder” epic heavy rocket launcher from 5% to 7%, and its periodic energy damage was increased by 80%.
[*] The periodic fire damage of the exclusive “Carnage-15EX” shotgun was halved, but its direct total damage from the shot was increased by 102.
[/olist]


[h1]Innovations[/h1][olist]
[*] The legendary energy shotgun for MK-2: “Pyroclasm” was added to the game! Instead of simple fraction, he shoots with clots of plasma, which deal with 3 types of damage simultaneously. This is the first representative of this type of weapon.
[*] In addition, 2 new epic weapons were added for the MK-2: the “Mr. Cracker” machine gun and the “Proton” energy gun! The new machine gun has a special effect that has not yet been used in any other weapon. Which one? Find out when you get it :)
[*] Durability and defense values of Flamethrower and Guard turrets on Arenas with high PP on MK-2 (1900 and higher) were doubled, and their fire resistance rate was increased from 11 to 20%.
[*] Durability and defense values of Flamethrower and Guard turrets on Arenas with medium PP on MK-2 (1400-1900) were increased by 1.5 times.
[*] Now an engineering container of an epic rarity on the MK-2 can contain a legendary item.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32553324/f4dcda86452d4dd7cca17fa9b7d6cfea9ba1203e.png[/img]

[h1]Bugfix[/h1][olist]
[*] Improved synchronization of fire from weapons.
[*] Fixed additional experience rewards in case of totem capture.
[/olist]

This is just the beginning of Halloween celebrations! Stay tuned so you don’t miss all the “sweets”. In the meantime, keep the Spooky Predatory Halloween Promo Code: DTRD-F0G2-9WQV

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello Commanders! In today's update, meet the new epic high-precision gun - Amper-M2! We also improved the performance of the combat server and fixed several bugs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32553324/2fce030589f7d9ee1747b547b71522029cdf2f13.png[/img]

[*] An epic high-precision gun for the MK-2: “Amper-M2” was added to the game! This is a modernized version of the exclusive “Amper” made of meteorite steel with long stunning times and additional periodic damage from fire and energy. In addition, he shoots special red plasma shells and has his own animated effect in the hangar.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32553324/10d7de238fd277e1e8ae368a9fa42c9f10e9ba4e.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello Commanders! Meet the first post-release update! 3 exclusive weapons for MK2 were added to the game, the reward in credits and experience for playing in the squad was increased, and the combat rate of single-shot weapons was fixed by popular demand. Read about these and other innovations and changes in the full patchnote!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32553324/0347bc15bdd6ac0b92aa0d6d9e71655f5b422370.png[/img]

[h1]New weapons[/h1][olist]
[*] 3 weapons of an exclusive rarity for MK-2 were added to the game:
[list]
[*] Exclusive Machine Gun “Squall-15EX”
[*] Exclusive Shotgun “Carnage-15EX”
[*] Exclusive Energy Weapon “Spark-15EX”
[/list]
[*] These weapons and their blueprints can be obtained as a reward for the battle.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32553324/aca0e4faa2702f96c437251577f516ec41886187.png[/img]

[*] “Explosive Starter Pack” can now be purchased from level 7 to 25 (previously it was up to level 20).

[*] Fixed the cost of containers with resources that appear in the assortment of the Daily Store.

That's all for today. And do not forget that if in your opinion, something doesn’t work as it should in the game, you can always tell us about it on our server in Discord (https://discord.gg/deuteriumwars)

notes.title: Release Tournament: Epic Battle!
notes.notes:
Commanders, in honor of the release of the game on Steam, we have prepared 2 in-game tournaments in Deuterium Wars. Which of them to participate in, or even try to win prizes in both, depends only on your preferences in the battle style and your choice of MK.

The tournament will last [b]2 weeks[/b], but in order to manage to get all the rewards for the stages of these events, as well as get one of the prize places, join the battle right now!

[h1]Epic battle MK1. [/h1]
Get as many points as possible for battles on MK1 in the competition for the epic skeleton "Rock". In addition to the frame, the first three winners will receive other special awards. Tournament rewards are provided for the first 100 fighters in the tournament ranking.

[h1]Epic battle MK2. [/h1]
Win as many times as possible on MK2 in the competition for the Levafan epic frame and the epic engineering container, which will go to the top three leaders in the tournament. For 4-5 place players will receive similar exclusive, and for 6-10 - unique awards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32553324/9d8224ca0cfb61e4b5a168af5bd0a2a711b7e88f.png[/img]

To the strongest and boldest of you, we wish victory in tournaments! But even if one of you fails to get into the leaderboard, fulfilling the conditions of the stages of these tournaments will bring you a lot of experience, credits, and special rewards!

notes.title: Update 1.0.0. Release in STEAM
notes.notes:
Commanders, welcome the release update! The maximum level of the character was increased from 100 to 140. For achieving each level in this range you will receive a guaranteed container with a resource of exclusive rarity. In addition, you will find many other interesting innovations, changes and awards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32553324/6599b78e9933c9d93ff600f2a9b4e2a666fc78b4.png[/img]

[h1]Graphics[/h1]
[olist]
[*] What happened is what you all have been waiting for so long: added sprites for the epic armor MK-2!
[*] Updated sprites of armor elements MK-1 and MK-2.
[*] Craft
[*] The experience gained from assembling items has been increased by 200%.
[*] Now you will receive experience for improving items in the amount of 50% of the experience gained for assembling an item of the same duration.
[/olist]

[h1]Battle Items[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Due to the addition of sprites for epic armor, the elements of this armor, as well as its drawings, were returned to the drop table and they can fall out again!
[*] Added the “Rock” epic steel frame for the MK-1 with two slots for a reinforced frame and even greater features! Its drawing can be obtained already from level 30, and the frame can be obtained and used from level 35.
[*] Added “Leviathan” epic meteorite frame for MK-2 with two slots for a reinforced frame and even greater characteristics. Its drawing can be obtained already from level 110, and the frame can be obtained and used from level 120.
[*] Added 9 battle modifiers for MK-2.
[*] Added 22 power panels with a modification of fire protection and 22 energy panels with a modification of energy protection.
[*] Added heat traps of a unique rarity for MK-1 and MK-2.
[*] The first 2 shooting ranges of drones and detonators of usual rarity were added to the assortment of the Store.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32553324/0e3378308258fa8ab57a349c12084944490a954b.png[/img]

[h1]Containers[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Epic containers with resources on MK-1 and MK-2 were added to the game, from which even a resource of legendary rarity can fall!
[*] Now an epic resource may drop out of a container with an exclusive rarity resource with a small chance.
[*] An epic engineering container for the MK-2 has also been added.
[/olist]

[h1]Daily Store[/h1]
[olist]
[*] On weekends, special containers with 20 units of a certain resource of common rarity will appear in the assortment of the Daily Store: sheets of bronze, sheets of glass, scrap metal, useful parts or tempered glass.
[*] In the assortment of the Daily Store, starting at level 36, Optical fiber will periodically appear.
[/olist]

[h1]Battle Rewards[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Starting from level 100, winning at the Arena of any MK, you have a chance to get the legendary Champion's Chest. But for this it is necessary to take first place in score in the table of battle results.
[*] The frequency of unique, exclusive and epic resources drop as a reward for a battle has been increased by 40%, however, now they can only drop out if a player takes 3rd or higher place in the battle results table.
[*] The frequency of exclusive and epic weapons containers drop, as well as frequency of exclusive and epic gadgets and enhancements drop has been increased by 20%, however, now they can only drop out if the player takes 4th or higher place in the battle results table (not the last).
[*] However, the chances of unique weapons, gadgets and enhancements drop (directly by the reward for the battle, not from the container) were reduced by 40% from their original value.
[*] If you commit 10 or more kills or gain 2000 or more score per battle, regardless of the fact of victory or defeat, there is a 20% chance to get an extra reward in the form of an engineering container of common, unique or exclusive rarity!
[*] In case you capture a totem, there is a 20% chance to get an additional reward in the form of a container with resources of common or unique rarity!
[/olist]

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Added “Ocean of money” achievement which you can get by collecting 1 billion credits.
[*] Added “Win Streak VI” achievement which you can get by performing 50 victories in row. You will be awarded by exclusive engineering container for that.
[*] Added “Secret Codes V” achievement which you can get by using 25 promocodes.
[*] Added “Armed to the teeth!” achievement which you can get by reaching 2000 PP or more on your hovercraft.
[*] Now, in addition to experience and deuterium, an unique engineering container will be given as a reward for achieving the “Win Streak IV”, and an exclusive one for the “Win Streak V”.
[*] Similar rewards were added to the achievements of “Unstoppable Death” and “Arena Thunderstorm” (for 40 and 50 kills without a single death).
[*] Now instead of unique shotgun and exclusive radio enhancement you will get an unique and an exclusive container as rewards for 100 and 1000 victories achievements.
[*] You will get “Unlimited Progress” achievement for reaching 140 level.
[/olist]

[h1] Experience Bonuses[/h1]
[olist]
[*] The bonus of experience gained from dog tags has been increased: now they give 2-7% of additional experience depending on rarity (previously it was 1-5%).
[*] On items of exclusive rarity, where previously there was 1 slot for a dog tag, now as many as 2 slots for dog tags!
[*] The experience bonuses on the MK-2 epic armor were increased from 3% to 5%.
[/olist]

[h1]Other Enhancements[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Over 20 new tips that will be displayed on the battle loading screen have been added to the game. For advice, many thanks to the players who took part in the advices contest. Now all pilots of Deuterium Wars will know about them!
[*] The tip “Don't forget to recharge” has been removed from the game, because it’s not relevant.
[*] “News” and “Support” menu buttons in Hangar have been enabled.
[/olist]

[h1]Bugfix[/h1]
[olist]
[*] The mechanism of the resources drop when disassembling items has been fixed if in the scheme of the item these resources are contained in the amount of 1 pc.
[*] Fixed bots behaviour and power in the first tutorial battles on the Arena.
[*] Fixed turret icon on drawings of portable MK-2 turrets.
[*] The word “phoenix” is no longer perceived by the game chat filter as obscene language.
[*] Fixed english localization of Iron Oil Radiator.
[*] Fixed problem areas in the lower part of the Trade District arena where it was possible to get stuck on the MK-2 hovercraft.
[*] Enhanced german and ukrainian localizations.
[*] The number of Achievement Points gaining for the achievement “Altanar Multimillionaire” has been fixed.
[*] Now, “Caster's Notes II” can be obtained in battles on the MK-2 arena (previously it was possible to get it only on MK-1).
[*] Fixed iron melting blueprint drop.
[*] Fixed costs of unique and exclusive acid detonators on MK-2.
[*] The drop chances for exclusive resources from containers with resources have been fixed and now they better correspond to their usage frequency in craft.
[/olist]

Friends, thank you all for your help in developing Deuterium Wars during the open beta. Every day we will try to make Deuterium Wars even better and more interesting. And we really hope for your support. This promotional code is for you: UJEC-FT6T-N396.

notes.title: Hotfix 27.09.2019

notes.title: Update 0.5.7
notes.notes:
Hello, commanders! Today we have prepared for you some surprises: “the warming-up phase” before the start of the battle, the new arena, the new pick-ups in the battle, the danger zones and much more. Looking forward to your feedback.

[h1]Warming-up phase[/h1]
Added warming-up phase - preparation before the start of the Arena battle:
[olist]
[*] The warming-up phase begins after the player enters the battle room on the Arena.
[*] During this phase, the participants in the room can fight as usual, but at the end of the phase, the arena is restored and the participants return to the spawn points.
[*] At the end of the warm-up phase, a 5 seconds timer starts before the start of the battle.
[*] The warm-up phase lasts up to 2 minutes after the creation of the battle room. 
[*] During the Warm-up phase, but not earlier than 15 seconds after it starts, players can vote for the quick start of the battle (to vote, the player must press F1).
[*] The 5-second timer of the beginning of the battle starts immediately, as soon as 70% of players or more vote for a quick start.

notes.title: Update 0.5.5
notes.notes:
Hello, commanders! We continue to respond quickly to your feedback in social networks and Steam. Today we have:
[list]
[*] New map + experimental mode with a battle for one Totem.
[*] Reduction of crafting time (including modification, disassembly and opening of containers).
[*] New training for beginners.
[*] Many other improvements, innovations and balance edits.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32553324/5cd3aee267fdcc5167d10a3221c10800e6b56a85.jpg[/img]

[h1]Battle[/h1]
A new Arena map has been added: Thicket! In the Command Dethmatch mode, there is the only one neutral totem on it. This is the first and so far the only map of the Arena with such a feature.
[olist]
[*] The ability to customize the value of the auto aim weapon sector has been added: you can set a value from 5 to 60 degrees. By default, for gamepads the value is 50 degrees, and for a computer mouse - 30 degrees.
[*] Matchmaking is changed in such a way that now squads play only with squads, and singles - only with singles.
[*] If a player loose in a 1,5 minutes, this fight does not count for him as a loss.
[*] “Conquest” mode was renamed to “Conquest of Points”, and “Arena” - to “Team Deathmatch”.
[*] In the “Two Forts” arena, more repair pickups were added at its bottom.
[*] More pick-ups have been added to the Crystal Grotto arena.
[*] Fixed a problem place in the center of the Sand Arena, where bots were often stuck.
[*] When passing the Trial to increase the division, a draw is now equivalent to a victory.
[*] Added logic of bots response to stationary turrets:
  • they do not ignore them when they fly by;
  • switch to turrets and try to destroy them, while maintaining a distance;
  • in order not to die quickly under the fire of a turret, use a tomb and / or power board, if any.
[*] Fixed and improved the algorithm of avoiding Allied players by bots:
  • now they are much less likely to ram the Allied player, who blocks the passage of the bot and he will wait a few seconds for the passage to be cleared before he tries to fly there again.
  • if it is possible, the bot builds itself an alternative path of approximately the same length and flies around the player.
[/olist]
[h1]Rewards for battle[/h1]
By popular demand, we are improving the “drop” to make you feel like a winner who got some loot after battle, and not the truck driver who successfully robbed the local landfill :)
[olist]
[*] The drop of engineering resources of ordinary rarity (with the exception of coal, gunpowder, explosives and metal ingots) was disabled.
[*] However, resources of unique rarity can now be mined 33% more often.
[*] Now, on average, once in 3 battles in the Arena, you will receive a "damaged" combat item, which is inferior in terms of its prototype characteristics; it contains a reduced amount of resources and has a low price. By examining such items, you will receive more resources of ordinary rarity than you previously received as a reward for the battle. You may disassemble these items quickly: for 1 minute.
[*] The chances of combat modifiers, weapons, equipment, and enhancements of unique rarities, as well as unique blueprints, were increased by 17%.
[*] The chances of combat modifiers and blueprints of ordinary rarity were also increased by 17%.
[*] The chances of combat modifiers were redistributed in such a way that they now better correspond to the frequency of their use in hovercraft slots.
[*] MK-2 frameworks were added to the game with an energy and acid protection bonus, as well as MK-1 steel frameworks with an acid protection bonus - you can get them as a reward for the Arena battle.
[/olist]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32553324/023e3551abeed419bc08c77a4157d7a4142a39dd.jpg[/img]

[h1]Item Balance[/h1]
Despite earlier changes, rocket launchers created a big problem for their opponents with rocket “spam”, which was unreasonably difficult to resist. The latest changes will simplify maneuvers between rockets without depriving the rocket launchers of their destructive power and the main feature - the range.
[olist]
[*] The blast radius of rocket launchers was reduced by 33%.
[*] The auto aiming of missiles fired from rocket launchers to the target during the flight was turned off, and for heavy rocket launchers it was weakened for 4 times.
[*] The range of missiles of heavy rocket launchers is now 25% longer than that of rockets fired from rocket launchers.
[*] Direct damage from flame thrower and acid throwers has been increased by 20%, however, their periodic damage has been reduced by 20%.
[*] The required level of the exclusive Brut shotgun was raised from 16 to 26, as his firepower was unreasonably high for level 16.
[/olist]
[h1]Craft[/h1]
REALY a lot of players scolded us for extremely long craft, which at high levels for very rare items could reach two days. Such a balance is considered the normal for mobile games, where acceleration is available through advertising, as well as the gameplay itself is a little different. So we made a strong-willed decision to reduce crafting time many times. So rejoice and leave us complimentary reviews on Steam (please), because:
[olist]
[*] The opening time of containers has been reduced and is now:
  • 1-10 minutes for containers of the usual rarity;
  • 10-30 minutes for containers of unique rarity;
  • 30-60 minutes for containers of exclusive rarity;
  • 1-4 hours for containers of epic rarity.
[*] Thus, for most of the containers, the opening time has decreased by 10-20 times.
[*] The time for disassembling trash has been reduced and now can not be more than 2 minutes.
[*] The time for removing combat modifiers from an item has been reduced by 70% and now amounts to 30% of the time they were applied to an item.
[*] The time for using combat modifiers was reduced to values ​​similar to the opening times for containers of the corresponding rarities. The time of application of modifiers decreased by 6-12 times for most of them.
[*] The assembly time of items has been reduced to values ​​similar to the opening times of containers of corresponding rarities. The time of assembly and disassembly of items was reduced by 6-20 times for most items.
[*] Added the ability to disassemble items of junk of legendary rarity.
[*] The assembly time of weapons, equipment and boosts of the 1st tier has been reduced from 10 minutes to 5 minutes.
[*] Added the ability to quickly send items to disassemble using the Shift key.
[*] Added the ability to collect the results of crafting using the Shift key.
[*] The magnitude of the reduction in the time of craft processes with the help of Craft Accelerators was revised. Now you can purchase the following boosters in the game:
 • for 1 minute;
 • for 10 minutes;
 • for 30 minutes;
 • for 1 hour;
 • for 4 hours;
 • for 8 hours.
[*] At the same time, the cost of acceleration without the use of accelerators is now 1 Deuterium per 1 minute of acceleration.
[/olist]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32553324/7185fb4c1d70e0c404147a9ad5c44968ed14729b.jpg[/img]
[h1]Other innovations[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Reworked initial education system:
  • Now the beginner from the very beginning of the game has a choice: go immediately to the Arena or to Campania;
  • The first training mission was finalized and moved to the Campaign as the first mission called Prolog;
  • Frank Horrorgan no longer destroys the player’s hover at the end of the first mission;
  • In the first 3 battles in the Arena, a novice is taught to play in various Arena modes, explaining their features.
[*] Promo code for attentive: G7G4-2FKS-72HT (1000 activations, valid until 06.06.19)
[*] There is an option to automatically sell useless junk (included in the UI settings).
[*] Added 2 steel frames of exclusive rarity on the MK-1: one with an emphasis on survival, the other - in mobility and damage.
[*] Added an exclusive assault shotgun for the MK-1 - "The Nutcracker", which can be used from level 16.
[*] Improved assortment of Daily Store:
  • added blueprints of equipment, causing damage from acid;
  • added blueprints of portable turrets;
  • added blueprints to create sheets of bronze, iron and steel from the corresponding ingots;
  • increased the range of weapons at 66-80 levels (including steel weapons with combat modifications were added there);
  • increased the range of unique weapons at 36-40 levels.
  • Now every day at the 36-100 levels in the Daily Shop with a 10% chance, a random resource of exclusive rarity may appear (at 36-70 levels, an exclusive resource for the MK-1, and at 71-100 for the MK-2).
[*] The word "Skin" was added to the names of all the decorative sets for hovercraft.
[*] Updated sprite of the high-precision gun "Rhino".
[*] Improved text description of events.
[*] Added the ability to completely block your account. Criminals can now get banned in the game.
[*] Added one-time free Premium for 1 day.
[/olist]
[h1]Bugfix[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Fixed display of the progress of the division / league in the battle results window and in the Journal.
[*] Fixed direct damage caused by exclusive mines "Surprise" and bombs "Bum-Bum!".
[*] The free bronze top armor MK-2 with the modification of Critical Damage Protection has been removed from the battle rewards.
[*] Fixed the icon for armor plates of the usual rarity.
[*] Fixed reward for achieving level 54.
[*] Fixed a bug with "missing letters" in the texts.
[*] Fixed a bug with the first character creation, when he momentarily appeared in the garage only in underwear.
[*] Fixed Damage per second displayed in the information window characteristics hovercraft.
[*] Fixed a number of errors leading to the crash of the game.
[*] Added German localization of legendary resources.
[*] The German localization of the “Granite of Science” achievement series has been added.
[*] Fixed marking of the exclusive gain of the Iskatel-160EX radio in the English and Ukrainian localizations.
[*] Fixed a bug with simultaneous crafting on one machine.
[*] Fixed a long load at the entrance to the garage.
[*] Fixed display of the flamethrower in the bottom panel of the Hangar.
[*] With a bath in the chat, you can see the entire cause and term of the ban.
[*] Trophies in the “Junk” tab are now allocated a separate subsection “Trophy”.
[/olist]

This patchout is just huge. We hope that we managed to make a favorable impression on you. If you have read everything carefully, you will surely find a promotional code in the "Other innovations" section. Share your impressions with us in the comments and please write a review about the game here on Steam, if you have not done so already.

notes.title: Update 0.5.3
notes.notes:
Hello, commanders! A week ago Deuterium Wars has released to Early Access. How time flies! We want to thank again everyone for your feedback. Positive reviews inspire us, negative ones make us get better to get your favor anyway!

Today we present an update that is fully based on your feedback about the game. We have improved the balance of weapons, drop and "friendliness of the hangar" to the player. 

[img] https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32553324/a574bda854f5cf5d717062d12da4503456d99692.jpg [/img]

[h1] The most important [/h1]
[list]
[*] We have added acid bombs, mines and rockets. There are over 100 new items!
[*] The weapon balance has been reworked: including rocket launchers, shotguns and machine guns [i](see Item Balance)[/i]
[*] Added the 3rd and 4th missions of the Campaign: “In the mansion” and “Test of the Four”.
[*] Reduced cost for many actions in the Hangar.
[*] The value of the containers has been increased. Now, in addition to the main item and resources, there will be a drawing in them. At the same time the frequency of containers drop is reduced.
[*] Added German localization of the game.
[/list]
[img] https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32553324/fc5806556249aa2e04ec73bf027b78167d7a1010.jpg [/img]

[h1] Item Balance [/h1]
[list]
[*] The initial flight speed of missiles launched by rocket launchers was reduced by 30%. The range of their flight was reduced by 66%. These changes also affected the missiles that are produced by large rocket turrets in the Arena.
[*] The drop of the damage from a shotguns has been increased by 58%. Now the damage done by them at the maximum distance is 4 times lower than the initial damage.
[*] The maximum distance of fire from machine guns and SMG was increased by 10%, and the loss of damage from their shells was reduced by 13% (that is, the damage at long range is now 80-85% of the original).
[*] The repulsive force for machine-gun bullets was increased 4 times, and for SMG bullets 5 times. Now the owners of such weapons can effectively repel the enemy from a squall, preventing them from approaching.
[*] Now on combat items of ordinary rarity there are all slots for combat modifiers, which are available on similar items of unique rarity.
[*] Now the number of triggers of Heat Traps is unlimited, and the safety margin of each charge launched by them is also unlimited. This means that the charges of heat traps are no longer destroyed by missiles and can fully protect during the entire time of their life.
[*] The direct and periodic damage of the Flame of War flamethrower is rebalanced in such a way that it destroys an enemy of equal strength in about 5 seconds of continuous fire. At the same time, the duration of the Fire Effect applied by it was increased to 10 seconds, and the frequency of ticks of damage was increased by 312%.
[*] The duration of the Corrosion Effect applied by acid meters was increased to 10 seconds, and the frequency of damage ticks was increased by 151%. However, they now do not deal direct damage.
[*] The recovery time of stealth generators has been increased from 2.5 to 3.5 seconds.
[*] Added an additional fire effect for exclusive BomBum! Bombs and Surprise exclusive mines.
[/list]
[h1] Hangar [/h1]
[list]
[*] Now new players get 2 more rows of Warehouse cells for free.
[*] The cost of expanding the Inventory sections now increases by 10% slower with each subsequent expansion.
[*] The cost of expanding the Slots Market has been reduced by 50%.
[*] The term for placing lots in the Market has been reduced to 3 days.
[*] The cost of expanding the Book of Drawings has been reduced by 2 times.
[*] The experience gained for assembling items has been doubled.
[*] Now you can get a small amount of experience for disassembling items.
[*] The scheme for assembling exclusive mines Surprise has been changed: now instead of tin cans, there are used bronze sheets as a resource.
[/list]
[img] https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32553324/17ec814a6478cb1be1e6e804ffd6b1ca732b23f5.jpg [/img]

[h1] Other [/h1]
[list]
[*] Notification of the imminent start of technical work will now appear in advance right in the game.
[*] The Hammer cannon received an updated sprite.
[*] The ice shelters in the Ice Grotto have been removed to make navigation easier.
[*] On the “Slum” map in TDM mode, the large Machine Gun Turret was replaced with a large Flame Turret.
[*] The result of the battle "Draw" in the Trials is now counted in favor of the player.
[*] Improved marking frameworks.
[*] Added the display of the status of "you noticed" in the line of buffs, if the enemy team sees the hovercraft in stealth mode.
[*] The icon of the Flame series rocket launchers on MK-1 has been improved
[*] To reduce the load on the video card, the maximum limit of FPS was set to 240 frames per second.
[*] Reworked the display of “Special effects” in the hints of gadgets of missiles, bombs and mines.
[*] Added the ability to disable the effects of the combat interface (bullet holes, burning screen) in the Settings for additional optimization on weak graphics cards.
[*] The system for awarding first battles has been improved.
[*] All bombs, mines and rockets can now take periodic damage (Acid, Fire, Electricity).
[*] The position of awards notifications in the Event window has been fixed.
[*] Added a difference limit for divisions in the Platoon - now high-ranking players will not be able to play in low-ranking platoons.
[*] The rarity of the “Old Tire” trash item has been changed to “useless”.
[/list]
[h1] Bugfix [/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed assembly schemes for reinforced frames MK-2.
[*] Old gains not falling out of the containers were removed from the production table.
[*] The bug of multiple overlapping of the same buff / debuff has been fixed - now in this case the time counter on the current buff is simply reset.
[*] Fixed the bug with the disappearance of some players in battle
[*] Fixed a critical error in the filter, which led to his absolutely chaotic work.
[*] The icons for the achievements “Need more power” and “Overflowing power” have been fixed.
[*] The bug of the infinite freezing of the flamethrower's sound at the death of a hovercraft was fixed.
[*] Fixed a critical error due to which messages were duplicated in personal chats.
[*] The popup was removed with a request to fill in the Questionnaire when leaving the game.
[*] Fixed a bug with the “Invalid price” window when placing goods on the Market.
[*] Fixed a bug with the “jumping” hint of an item in the Market.
[/list]

Thank you for reading. We continue to work actively. The next update will not take long. If you like this update, please email us a positive review on Steam or change your negative feedback to positive if you are satisfied with the work we have done! And this is a promotional code as a gift: [b]8NJD-DQHP-XXA6[/b] (1000 activations)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/455300/Deuterium_Wars/

notes.title: Update 0.5.2
notes.notes:
Hello, commanders! Many thanks to everyone for the feedback and the warm welcome on Steam. But we are sure that we can become even better. And therefore we have prepared for you this update in order to correct what you asked the most about. If you gave us a negative review, read the patchnote carefully. You will probably change anger to mercy. Also, you will find a surprise at the end.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32553324/11172aa9556810e18047f1a6afa07715df090861.jpg[/img]

[h1]Major changes[/h1]
[olist]
[*] The second and third crafting slots could be purchased not only for deuterium, but also for gold.
[*] We have added 16 drones with a combat modification of the radius of the view, so that you can see everything clearly.
[*] Direct damage from "Warfire" flamethrower and "Cobra" acidthrower was reduced by 2 times. Now the main damage is caused by burning and corrosion, respectively.
[*] In order not to litter your inventory, all containers can now be stored in the amount of 5 pieces in 1 cell.
[*] Added a new rarity for items: "useless." Items of such rarity are not involved in the craft and can only be sold. However, trash items of such rarity can be useful for achieving achievements on a collection of trash.
[*] The cans, beverage cans, bottles and dolls are now useless rarities and cannot be disassembled. The value of resources derived from them was too low to occupy the craft machine.
[*] Added the ability to sell all useless junk, which is located in the Warehouse, at the touch of a button.
[*] Improved the obscene filter in the chat.
[*] Improved Battle Arenas rotation mechanism - the probability of repeating the same Arena two times in a row is significantly reduced.
[*] Added notification of disabled Steam Overlay.
[*] From now on, drones do not collide with Allied missiles, bombs, hovercraft and turrets.
[*] The column “Additional effects” was renamed to “Special effects” in the information windows of the weapon.
[/olist]
[h1]Campaign[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Increased the display time of the dialogue replicas in the second mission.
[*] Now it is clearly written that the third and subsequent missions are still in development.
[/olist]
[h1]Bagfix[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug with the unexpcted loss after a victory or a draw.
[*] Fixed several bugs with graphic artifacts.
[*] Fixed several bugs in localizations.
[*] Fixed display of damage in the hint of "Armageddon".
[/olist]

Thank you for reading to the end. As a sign of our gratitude for your patient waiting for the completion of server maintainance, we are giving you this promotional code: [b]8LUA-H9CV-P4K8[/b]
